# Release Notes: v1.0.7

## New

- Historical insights dashboard with monthly trend comparisons
- Personal data export (JSON) from the History screen
- First-week guidance card with state-driven onboarding
- Daily target status feedback (under/at/over per tracker)

## Reliability

- Clearer offline and pending mutation states — the app now shows
  explicit pending-write indicators when connectivity is slow or
  unavailable
- TrackerForm double-tap protection — prevents duplicate saves
- EndDay dialog failure/retry behavior — the dialog remains open
  until `endDay()` succeeds

## Security

- Android release builds now use Play Integrity for App Check
  (previously used the debug provider, which was inert)
- Web App Check remains on reCAPTCHA Enterprise
- App Check enforcement remains OFF — this is an advisory upgrade,
  not an enforcement activation. The authorization boundary is still
  carried by Firestore Security Rules plus API key restrictions

## Maintenance

- Deterministic Node/npm CI toolchain (Node 22.23.2, npm 10.9.8)
- Lockfile validation guard prevents incompatible `libc` metadata
  that previously caused npm audit HTTP 400 failures

### External (not automated — must be verified manually)

#### Required to publish GitHub APK

- [ ] `release` environment secrets present:
  - `GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64`
  - `TABAKPP_KEYSTORE_BASE64`
  - `TABAKPP_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`
  - `TABAKPP_KEY_ALIAS`
  - `TABAKPP_KEY_PASSWORD`
- [ ] Release tag `v1.0.7` does not exist remotely
- [ ] Dispatch release workflow from `main`

#### Required for Play Integrity attestation (NOT required for v1.0.7 release)

- [ ] Google Play developer account registered
- [ ] App entry created in Play Console
- [ ] Play Console → App integrity → Play Integrity API linked to Firebase project
- [ ] Release signing SHA-256 registered in Firebase Console → App Check → Play Integrity
- [ ] App Check advanced settings: PLAY_RECOGNIZED=not required, LICENSED=not required, Device integrity=required

#### Required before future App Check enforcement (NOT v1.0.7 scope)

- [ ] Release APKs distributed and App Check metrics verified in Firebase Console
- [ ] Enforcement decision documented
